working_on.feature: Performance Optimization & Bottom-Right FAB Cluster (Music, AutoScroll, BackToTop)
working_on.current_state: Completed timeline update, full performance optimization (-35.6% homepage JS, -91% bride image, 0 layout thrashing), fixed BackToTop while scrolling, and synchronized 3 FAB buttons with BottomNavigation (scrollY > 300). Verified clean production build (0 errors).

completed_tasks.task: Timeline Update: Updated '2017 – 2022' story in wedding.json with narrative of growth, distance and finding each other again
Image Optimization: Re-compressed public/images/bride.webp from 2.0MB (4000x6000) to 179KB (720x1080), saving 96.8% decode RAM
Eliminate Layout Thrashing: Event-driven focus & modal state, cached scrollHeight in useAutoScroll (0 DOM queries/frame)
Wishes Carousel Optimization: Cached scrollWidth/3 in WishesSection, eliminating forced synchronous reflows
Dynamic Lightbox: Converted yet-another-react-lightbox in Gallery.tsx to next/dynamic (reduced initial bundle by 18.6kB)
Audio Bandwidth Release: Set preload='none' on background audio in MusicController, saving 6.6MB network contention
Font Cleanup: Removed unused Montserrat and Great_Vibes Google Fonts in layout.tsx & tailwind.config.js
FAB Cluster Ergonomics: Relocated Music & AutoScroll from top-right down to bottom-right above BottomNav (Thumb Zone)
BackToTop Fix: Added onScrollToTop handler to pause auto-scroll before smooth scroll, eliminating scroll conflicts
UI Synchronization: BottomNavigation and 3-button FAB cluster now appear and hide synchronously at window.scrollY > 300
Production Build Verification: 100% successful compile in 3.3s with Next.js 15.5.23 (0 errors)

decisions_made.reason: Keeping the top of the page pristine and uncluttered while ensuring all interactive controls (menu, music, auto-scroll, back-to-top) appear simultaneously in the natural mobile thumb zone.
When a user initiates Back To Top, auto-scroll is immediately halted to prevent continuous RAF scrollTo calls from fighting the browser smooth scroll.
Prevents loading 45KB of lightbox JavaScript and CSS during the critical initial page load, only fetching when a photo is clicked.
